profile.name: Omik
profile.headline: Engineering fault-tolerant cloud platforms, reproducible CI/CD delivery pipelines, and low-latency telemetry infrastructure.
profile.status: Available for Platform Engineering, SRE Contracts & Infrastructure Migrations
about: I am a DevOps and Platform Systems Engineer operating from Bogura, Bangladesh (UTC+6). My engineering work centers on eliminating single points of failure, turning infrastructure into deterministic code, and designing systems that survive production stress without manual intervention.

Rather than relying on brittle cloud consoles and opaque managed services, I build platforms from the kernel and network up: reproducible state via SaltStack and Docker, hardened Layer-4/Layer-7 ingress with HAProxy and Nginx, robust CI/CD delivery pipelines, and deep observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager) that surface failure signals before users notice.

This portfolio itself is compiled directly in Rust using Maud macros with inlined critical CSS — delivering a single-pass ~27KB payload with zero render-blocking JavaScript and sub-30ms first contentful paint.

projects.title: High-Availability E-Commerce & CMS Cloud Platform
projects.headline: Fault-tolerant, auto-healing LAMP/LEMP platform orchestrated via wp-saltstack behind active-passive HAProxy and Nginx layer-7 ingress.
projects.problem: Monolithic e-commerce and CMS workloads deployed on single droplets suffered unmonitored crash loops, cascade failovers during traffic surges, and hours of configuration drift across development, staging, and production environments.
projects.solution: Engineered reproducible infrastructure state using SaltStack (wp-saltstack formula) with automated state enforcement across Debian/Ubuntu nodes. Ingress traffic terminates at dual HAProxy load balancers running keepalived for virtual IP failover, distributing requests to horizontally scaled Nginx + PHP-FPM worker pools with isolated MySQL replication replicas and automated Let's Encrypt TLS cycle management. Cut deployment recovery time from hours to sub-180s deterministic state convergence.

projects.title: Observability-First Telemetry Hub & Signal Aggregator
projects.headline: Unified metrics, structured log pipelines, and SLO-driven alerting engine across distributed bare-metal and container fleets.
projects.problem: Silent disk saturations, unindexed log explosions in production instances, and blind downtime notifications arriving only after customers opened urgent support tickets.
projects.solution: Designed and rolled out an end-to-end monitoring fabric centered on Prometheus with Node Exporter, Blackbox Exporter, and cAdvisor daemonsets scraping sub-second kernel and container counters. Telemetry feeds Grafana dashboards configured with golden signal visualization (latency, traffic, errors, saturation) and Alertmanager routing critical P1 thresholds to Discord/Slack webhooks while silencing transient spikes. Supplemented with systemd journalctl structured syslog pipelines to audit socket states and kernel OOM signals deterministically.

projects.title: Zero-Downtime CI/CD & Automated Delivery Engine
projects.headline: Git-driven automated pipeline with multi-stage OCI image compilation, local registry caching, and rolling blue-green rollbacks.
projects.problem: Manual SSH deployments, untagged Docker runtime changes, broken dependencies pulled live during deployments, and absence of automated smoke tests causing production outages on code push.
projects.solution: Constructed an automated GitOps delivery workflow triggered by Git commits. Pipeline executes linting and security vulnerability scanning (Trivy), executes multi-stage Docker builds leveraging Buildx Layer Caching, and pushes cryptographically tagged images to a private registry. Deployment orchestrates rolling container replacements behind health-check probes; on any non-200 HTTP response or container exit within 60s, the system triggers an automatic deterministic rollback to the previous SHA.

projects.title: Server-Side Tracking & Ad-Ops Telemetry Pipeline
projects.headline: Custom server-side GTM proxy and event broker preserving conversion telemetry through Safari ITP and ad-blocker signal loss.
projects.problem: Client-side tracking scripts were losing up to 35% of ad attribution and revenue telemetry due to aggressive ad-blockers, iOS privacy sandboxing, and Safari 7-day cookie expiration limits, distorting ROAS calculations.
projects.solution: Engineered a hardened Server-Side Google Tag Manager (sGTM) container cluster hosted on a custom first-party subdomain behind Nginx with Redis event deduplication. Client events send raw HTTP data payloads directly to the server container, which enriches, normalizes, and dispatches server-to-server calls to Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and GA4 Measurement Protocol with 99.4% event match quality and zero client CPU overhead.

projects.title: Autonomous Incident Triage & Operational Runbook Agent
projects.headline: Event-driven Python and Bash automation pipeline parsing alert webhooks, correlating journal logs, and drafting mitigation runbooks.
projects.problem: On-call fatigue caused by noisy infrastructure alerts requiring engineers to manually SSH into hosts, run standard diagnostic commands (dmesg, ss -tulpn, free -m, journalctl), and correlate time series.
projects.solution: Implemented a lightweight event daemon that receives Alertmanager webhook payloads, triggers non-destructive diagnostic telemetry collection over SSH via parameterized Bash scripts, sanitizes PII, and correlates output against historical operational runbooks using an LLM reasoning engine. Provides on-call engineers with an instant root-cause hypothesis and validated one-line mitigation commands within 8 seconds of alert firing.
